notes.title: Check out our progress for this week.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Just writing to show you a bit of the progress we have made this week on Miniverse Wars.

- Our new planet menu has been fully implemented and we hope it will make user experience much easier now. It will allow you to take all the actions related to your planets and show all the information you need about them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987989/f7c665a802dee0c36223d139aefdd5e2c561365e.png[/img]

- Our ships now look different according to their level of upgrade. The ships on the left-hand side are the ones with level 1 upgrade. See the evolution of the levels. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987989/29de94c97d7bc0e321d0e080921408a92ded9294.png[/img]

- We have also started the implementation of the planets' life bar and hope to complete it soon. 

And... we will have a new video soon to share with you :)

Thanks for reading!
